a: अशौचं — 1 Impurity, dirtiness, foulness; Pt. 1. 195. --2 Legal impurity or contamination; defilement caused either by child-birth (called जननाशौच) or by the death of some relation (called मृताशौच); it lasts for 10 days; during the मृताशौच a person defiled by it is not to touch any body else, or to eat with others in the same row or to do any sacred action; अहोरात्रमुपासीरन्नशौचं बांधवैः सह Ms. 11. 184. --Comp. --अंतः end of defilement. --संकरः blending or coming together of two or more defilements.
